samples.detection_method: Validate code signatures using trusted CA chains prior to update installation. Monitor SBOM changes to detect addition of unknown components such as backdoor modules. Endpoint process monitoring for unusual module loads within vendor software binaries. Network monitoring to detect encrypted outbound connections to unknown or suspicious C2 domains. File integrity monitoring on critical vendor paths and configuration files.

samples.detection_method: Validate digital signatures of updates using trusted vendor certificates. Use SBOM analysis to detect unexpected new components like 'backdoor_agent'. Registry monitoring for unauthorized module installations.
